title: Room Occupancy and the Persons Covered at Breakfast (Guest Folios, Elite Breakfast Benefit)
content:
For the Ashbury Rewards elite breakfast benefit on Guest Folios, the persons covered at breakfast follow the number of adults registered in the room.

**Rule.** Persons covered at breakfast: when the reservation behind the folio registers three or more adults and the member holds Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite, the persons covered at breakfast are the registered adults, up to the maximum persons covered of 4; when the reservation registers exactly one adult, one person is covered. Any other reservation keeps the brand's persons covered; this rule makes no change to it.

The registered adults are read from the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio — the number of adults registered in the room — and the tier from the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay.

## Occupancy table

| Adults registered on the Room Reservations record | Member's Ashbury Rewards tier | Persons covered at breakfast |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Any | 1 |
| 2 | Any | Unchanged by this rule (the brand's persons covered) |
| 3 | Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 3 |
| 4 | Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 4 |
| 5 or more | Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 4 (the maximum persons covered) |
| 3 or more | Any other tier | Unchanged by this rule (the brand's persons covered) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical reservations)

- **Two adults, Ambassador Elite.** Fewer than three adults, so the first tier does not apply, and the room does not register exactly one adult: no change.
- **Three adults, Ambassador Elite.** Three or more adults with a qualifying tier: three persons covered.
- **Six adults, Titanium Elite.** The registered adults are capped at the maximum of 4: four persons covered.
- **Three adults, Platinum Elite.** The tier is neither Titanium Elite nor Ambassador Elite: no change.
- **One adult, any tier.** One person covered.
